set.body: Create the cross-compiled modules/multivar foundation under package scalafim.multivar. Add typed SpaceId, Dimension, ComponentCount, IndexSet, BlockPartition, MvSpace, MultivarError, and a MatrixView surface over existing linalg primitives. Acceptance: depends only on linalg; compiles on JVM and JS; public constructors validate invariants; no mvpa, dataset, image, Breeze, Spark, or JVM-only dependency enters shared core.
set.title: Multivar core: typed spaces, dimensions, matrix views, errors
